rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent bent-and-canted mass across all four views, so it clears the multi-view coherence gate. The dominant gesture is understandable: a compact, slightly curved bar with a heavier upper portion. However, the access edge response is weak; the blue frontage is not met by a clearly public void, undercut, or entry seam, so the ground remains too sealed for the neighborhood-living contract. The stepped/terraced silhouette is acceptable as a compact section move, but it is not especially program-explicit in section. Overall this is massing-coherent and repairable, but it still under-serves the required active threshold and public-space figure.
